dependency_notes: S1 is a pure type/constant addition with no runtime dependencies on other stories. S2 (publish) and S3 (fetch) both extend device-sync.ts but in non-overlapping function namespaces; they can be implemented in parallel after S1 lands. S4 (E2E) depends on S2 and S3 completing — it tests the full round-trip. S5 (docs) is independent of all other stories and can be written in parallel with or after any story.
mock_resolution_plan: No temporary mocks are introduced. S2 uses the existing signer/client/relays interfaces from useMarmot(); S3 does the same. No mock needs to be resolved before epic completion.

seams.data: publishTaskStateSync function exported from device-sync.ts and called by GroupManager.tsx

invariants: Never rejects — failure is caught internally and logged via console.error
Caller is fire-and-forget; GroupManager.tsx MUST NOT await the return value in the UI handler path

seams.data: fetchAndApplyTaskBootstrap function exported from device-sync.ts and called by task-store.tsx

invariants: Returns Promise<TaskEvent[]> of synthetic task.created events that passed the CRDT gate
Never rejects — failure is caught internally; empty array returned on any error
An empty tasks[] payload in a fetched event produces zero returned TaskEvents
Only called when isGroupJoinedFromWelcome(groupId) returns true AND local event log is empty

seams.data: TaskStateSyncPayload interface defined in task-events.ts and consumed by device-sync.ts

invariants: version is always the literal number 1
type is always the literal string "task.state_sync"

stories.name: foundations-types-and-nip46-perms
stories.title: Foundations: TaskStateSyncPayload type and NIP-46 sign_event:30078 permission
stories.description: Adds the TaskStateSyncPayload TypeScript interface to task-events.ts and re-adds sign_event:30078 to the NIP46_PERMS constant in nostr.ts. Updates the REQUIRED_KINDS array in nostr.test.ts so the single-source-of-truth unit test continues to enforce the perms string. These are the foundational changes that S2 and S3 depend on.

includes: src/store/task-events.ts — add TaskStateSyncPayload interface (version, type, groupId, tasks, syncedAt, inviterPubkey)
src/lib/nostr.ts — add sign_event:30078 to NIP46_PERMS string constant
excludes: Any runtime logic: no publish or fetch functions in this story

stories.name: publish-side-inviter-task-state-sync
stories.title: Publish side: inviter publishes task state sync after invite
stories.description: Implements publishTaskStateSync in device-sync.ts: reads the current task state from IndexedDB via loadEvents+replayEvents, filters to non-deleted tasks, builds a TaskStateSyncPayload v1, NIP-44 encrypts to the invitee's pubkey, and publishes kind-30078 with d-tag notestr:task-sync:{groupId}:{inviteePubkeyHex}. Wires the call into GroupManager.tsx:handleInvite as a fire-and-forget after inviteByKeyPackageEvent succeeds. Failure is non-fatal.

includes: src/marmot/device-sync.ts — add publishTaskStateSync(groupId, inviteePubkeyHex, signer, client, relays): Promise<void>
src/components/GroupManager.tsx — call publishTaskStateSync fire-and-forget after inviteByKeyPackageEvent succeeds
Unit test for publishTaskStateSync: verify error is caught and not re-thrown; verify payload shape and d-tag
excludes: AC-1 full-stack validation — that is S4

stories.notes: GroupManager.tsx MUST NOT await publishTaskStateSync in the UI handler — the call is fire-and-forget to avoid blocking the invite confirmation UX. Use void publishTaskStateSync(...) or .catch(() => {}) pattern to satisfy TypeScript without awaiting.

stories.name: fetch-side-new-member-bootstrap
stories.title: Fetch side: new member bootstrap from relay on first load
stories.description: Implements fetchAndApplyTaskBootstrap in device-sync.ts: queries the relay for kind-30078 events matching the d-tag, NIP-44 decrypts each event, validates the payload, applies a CRDT merge gate (FWW/LWW) against the current in-memory state, and returns synthetic task.created TaskEvents for tasks that win the gate. Updates task-store.tsx:load() to call this function when the local event log is empty AND isGroupJoinedFromWelcome returns true, then appends the returned events and re-runs replayEvents.

includes: src/marmot/device-sync.ts — add fetchAndApplyTaskBootstrap(groupId, ownPubkey, signer, client, relays, currentState): Promise<TaskEvent[]>
src/store/task-store.tsx — update load() to call fetchAndApplyTaskBootstrap when event log is empty and isGroupJoinedFromWelcome is true; append returned events; re-run replayEvents
Unit tests: graceful degradation (no event found), idempotence, CRDT gate cases (empty payload, LWW ordering, multi-inviter convergence), manually-joined group skips fetch
excludes: UI indication of sync progress (optional per D5, not required for AC pass)

stories.notes: signer.nip44 is optional on EventSigner — guard with if (!signer.nip44) { console.error(...); return [] }. The CRDT gate must match the spec exactly: FWW for new tasks, LWW for existing tasks, deterministic tie-breaker by updatedBy pubkey string comparison. isGroupJoinedFromWelcome is accessed via the existing pattern in task-store.tsx (useMarmot chain).

Adds a second test case covering AC-3: A creates a group with no tasks, invites B, B joins, B sees an empty board with no error.

includes: e2e/tests/task-sync.spec.ts — update TP-30 to assert B sees A's pre-join tasks (not an empty board)

The assertion must be inverted: after S2+S3 land, B MUST see the tasks A created before the invite. Ensure the E2E test waits for the bootstrap fetch to complete (up to 5 seconds per AC-1) before asserting task visibility.
